# What Bitwig Agent can do

<!-- Generated by `pixi run capabilities` from src/bitwig_agent/protocol/capabilities.py and docs/verification/; do not edit by hand. -->

Each row is a task from the [Bitwig User Guide](https://www.bitwig.com/userguide/latest/) and the methods that do it: call them as MCP tools by these names, or from the shell as `bitwig-agent <group> <verb>` (`tracks.duplicate` is `bitwig-agent tracks duplicate`). Each method links to its reference in PROTOCOL.md.

**Verified on Bitwig 6.1.7 (Linux): 0 of 116 common tasks (0%).** Counted by the 145 rows of the feature audit they merge: 0 of 145 (0%).

| Status | Common tasks | Audit rows |
|---|---:|---:|
| ● Verified | 0 | 0 |
| ◔ Available, not yet verified | 86 | 107 |
| ◑ Partial | 13 | 18 |
| ○ Not supported | 17 | 20 |

- **Verified**: tested end to end on a real Bitwig 6.1.7 on Linux, and the methods have not changed since.
- **Available, not yet verified**: the methods exist and pass the offline tests, but no one has confirmed them on a real Bitwig yet.
- **Partial**: part of the task works; the row says what is missing.
- **Not supported**: no method does it yet.

Tasks marked † are less common and not counted above. Verification records read: 0.
